Our Programs

Healing Through Community

Every program under the Warrior Retreat umbrella is built around one truth: veterans heal better together than alone.

01
Flagship Program
The Warrior Retreat

AV's Warrior Retreats offer veterans a four-day fellowship for healing trauma through Post-Traumatic Growth and Wellbeing. A structured environment of brotherhood, reflection, and real healing.

Recreational activities are combined with therapeutic experiences to create a supportive environment for self-reflection and processing the struggles that come home with service.

FishingShootingKayakingEquine TherapyArt TherapyGroup Sessions
Apply Now
02
Marriage & Family
The Marriage Retreat

AV Couples' retreats acknowledge the unique transitions and traumas experienced by veterans' spouses, aiming to counter the high divorce rates among combat veterans.

The program fosters connection, open communication, reconciliation, and mutual respect — equipping couples with the education, tools, and support needed to navigate their PTG journey and renew their partnership.

Couples TherapyCommunication ToolsPTG FrameworkShared Activities
Apply Now
Community Support
Peer-to-Peer Programs

Our AV peer-to-peer (P2P) support programs, led by certified veteran peer-support specialists, offer mentoring, camaraderie, and a genuine sense of belonging.

Individual and group sessions are held at safe locations statewide — a force multiplier for everything else we do. Veterans helping veterans navigate the hardest parts of the transition.

Get Involved
Volunteer Program
AV Ambassador Program

The AV Ambassador Program (AVAP) engages veterans statewide through mentoring, outdoor activities, and resource facilitation. Ambassadors are the primary way Alabama Veteran reaches veterans in every corner of the state.

Be Someone's 9-Line.

  • Peer counseling and facilitating peer groups
  • Recruiting volunteers and coordinating outdoor events
  • Offering follow-up support to veterans in need
  • Representing AV at outreach events statewide
  • Connecting veterans in crisis with immediate assistance
What is the 9-Line?

In combat, the 9-Line report provides the critical information needed in seconds to collect a wounded warrior and get them to the next level of care. Alabama Veteran uses this same principle for veterans in crisis — providing immediate connection to housing, food, clothing, and support. Ambassadors are trained to be that lifeline.

Got Questions?

WE HAVE ANSWERS.

How are donations used to support veterans?

Your contributions fund Warrior Retreats, Marriage Retreats, Peer-to-Peer support, the AV Ambassador Program, Operation Christmas Elf, temporary housing, and direct assistance for utilities, food, vehicle repairs, clothing, and VA benefit navigation.

Are donations tax-deductible?

Yes. All donations to Alabama Veteran are fully tax-deductible. You will receive an official receipt immediately after your contribution. Corporate sponsors also receive an annual acknowledgment letter for CSR reporting. Our 990s are publicly available at alabamaveteran.org.

What do corporate sponsors receive?

Depending on your tier, you receive logo placement on our website and at events, the official Proud Supporter badge and full brand package, social media recognition, named program sponsorships, press announcements, employee engagement opportunities, and more. Full details are listed in each tier above.

Can my employees get involved too?

Absolutely. Titan Society and Champions League members receive employee engagement packages including volunteering at events, attending Warrior Retreats as supporters, and participating in fundraising campaigns. Contact us to build a custom program for your company.

Is there a minimum donation amount?

For individual supporters there is no minimum. Corporate tiers start at $250 per month. For custom packages, contact us at info@alabamaveteran.org and we will build something that works for your organization.

How does Alabama Veteran ensure transparency?

100% of your designated donation goes directly to the programs you choose. Our 990s are publicly available on our website and every donor receives documentation of how their gift was used.

Who We Are

WE'VE GOT YOUR SIX.

A 100% volunteer-run nonprofit dedicated to helping veterans find purpose in life after service.

Our Mission

HELPING VETERANS FIND PURPOSE AFTER SERVICE.

Alabama Veteran exists to empower and uplift our veteran community and their families across the state.

We stand ready to guide every veteran in Alabama with access and direction to a wide range of resources so they can connect with other Veterans, engage in meaningful volunteer activities, and successfully navigate their next mission: civilian life.

Since 2016, we have been 100% sustained by volunteers and donations. We're a Platinum Transparency charity — whatever you give, it goes right to the mission.

President
Chris Montz
Sr. Loan Officer · Edge Home Finance

A founding board member since 2017, Chris comes from a family of veterans and has spent over two decades specializing in VA home loans. He leads Alabama Veteran with a personal mission rooted in honor, service, and the belief that no veteran should navigate civilian life alone.

Chris 'Elroy' Stricklin
Air Force Colonel (ret) · Business Executive & Speaker

A three-time bestselling author and nationally recognized keynote speaker, Elroy served 23 years in the Air Force — from F-15C and the Thunderbirds to DARPA and the Pentagon, with combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan. He is a passionate advocate for veteran mental health.

Secretary

US Navy Reserves

An insurance and operations professional with a background in claims, Jesse is a Navy Seabee veteran who continues to serve in the Naval Reserves. He brings operational discipline and a ground-level veteran perspective to everything the organization does.

Parliamentarian

Corporate Counsel · Community Health Systems

An Air Force veteran and attorney specializing in business litigation and healthcare advisory services, Dylan has served as a senior health policy analyst in Washington, D.C. He also serves on the board of Dovetail Landing, supporting behavioral health services for veterans and their families.

Mike served nearly 40 years in the Alabama Army National Guard, retiring as Command Sergeant Major — the highest enlisted rank in the U.S. Armed Forces. GET AV ACTIVE

An app built for Alabama's veteran community — keeping vets connected, engaged, and moving forward long after the uniform comes off.

Get Early Access Become a Sponsor
Alabama Veteran Initiative

Built for Vets.
By Vets.

Too many veterans lose their sense of purpose and community after service ends. The transition to civilian life can be isolating — and that isolation has real consequences for mental health and well-being.

AV Active is a digital hub designed around the way veterans actually live. It brings together peer communication, fitness tracking, wellness resources, PTG programming, and real community events in one place — keeping Alabama vets engaged in a positive, productive way.

Corporate sponsors can connect with and support veterans through the app, helping track impact and fund activities that make a real difference.

Learn More
What AV Active Focuses On

The Five Pillars

Every feature in AV Active is built around these five commitments to the veteran community.

💬
Community

Stay connected with fellow Alabama vets, share experiences, and build the kind of brotherhood and sisterhood that doesn't end at ETS.

💪
Health & Fitness

Track workouts, join challenges, and stay accountable with other vets who understand what it means to push past the hard days.

🧠
Well-Being

Access mental wellness resources, PTG programming, and tools that support the whole person — not just the physical side of recovery.

🌱
PTG & Growth

Post-Traumatic Growth is at the heart of everything Alabama Veteran does. AV Active brings that framework into your daily life.

📅
Events & Challenges

From group rucks to War on the Greens, AV Active keeps you plugged into events and monthly challenges built for Alabama veterans.

How It Works

Four Simple Steps

01
Book Your Slot

Select an available 2-hour Platinum Hours block on the calendar. Spots fill up fast — grab your time early.

02
Complete Group Forms

Everyone in your group must complete the required forms and digital waivers before your booking is confirmed.

03
Check In On-Site

Arrive at Topgolf Birmingham and let the check-in desk know you have an Alabama Veteran reservation. Provide your mobile number as your alternate contact.

04
Play & Enjoy

Head to your bay and enjoy two hours of free gameplay — on us, because you served.

Program Rules

Open to verified veterans and active first responders only
Sessions are 2-hour blocks during Platinum Hours only
All group members must complete required forms and waivers before arrival
Each bay accommodates up to 6 players
Booking is not confirmed until all group forms are submitted
Cancellations must be made before the deadline in your confirmation
Currently available at the Birmingham (BHM) location only
Questions? Email topgolf@alabamaveteran.org
